test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following numbers will replace the question mark (?) in the given series? 

13, 26, 23, ?, 87, 522
solution:
The logic followed here is:

There are 2 operations going on, first multiplying by even number and subtraction of prime number. And the series goes like this

13 × 2 = 26

26 - 3 = 23

23 × 4 = **__92__**

92 - 5 = 87

87 × 6 = 522

So, the series is 13, 26, 23,** __92__,** 87, 522

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d87270e358d6b8c05eb067aa767b51a2226c45518614dc3dad49d2108bfa7f2.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** 92.**
